name: DX Cluster MCP Server
description: Enables interaction with Ham Radio DX Cluster networks to read and create spots, analyze band activity, and track propagation trends through Claude Desktop. It features secure Auth0 authentication and supports various cluster types including DXSpider and AR-Cluster.
